content:
We've been running iOS 27 for about two months now. Of course, it's a beta — the official version is still 4 to 6 weeks away. That said, even though I've been running the beta on my phone for the past two months, I can't say I've particularly noticed it. It just... works smoothly.

Of course, I still eagerly open the software update screen every couple of weeks or so to install the latest beta. That's the one constant of the entire iOS 27 beta experience.

Beyond that, I can't cite any of the usual complaints people bring up when talking about betas. Basically no battery drain, no overheating, no weird stutters, no random crashes popping up.

Running iOS 27 gives you all the benefits of the new system — Siri AI, AirPods EQ, new Wallet passes in Safari, beefier AI photo editing and more — with none of the usual drawbacks of running cutting-edge beta software. Honestly, that's quite an achievement.

iOS 26 itself wasn't exactly stable to begin with, which may be part of the reason. Especially iOS 26.5, which for some reason (at least for me) caused my phone to start experiencing frequent resprings.

That's all anecdotal, of course, but ask just about anyone and you'll hear some story about iOS 26 not behaving.

iOS 27 excels

That said, iOS 27 delivers impressively when it comes to speed improvements, bug fixes, stability and quality-of-life enhancements. You may not notice it at first, because Siri AI is doing a lot of background indexing — though Apple has recently pushed iOS 26.6, which kicks off that Siri AI indexing in the background, so you won't have to wait when you upgrade to iOS 27. Once you get past that step, it's smooth sailing.

I'm very much looking forward to the general public getting their hands on iOS 27 when the official version launches next month. It seems hard to believe, but it really does feel like Apple has fixed all the major iOS annoyances. Of course, it's not perfect — software never is — but this is absolutely the best iPhone experience I can remember.

iOS 27 will support all iPhone models that supported iOS 26, meaning iPhone 11 and newer will all receive the update.

My favourite Apple accessory recommendations:

  • Anker MagSafe/Qi2 ultra-slim external battery
  • AirPods Pro 3 (twice the active noise cancellation of AirPods Pro 2!)
  • Anker Nano 45W fast charger with smart display
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 MacBook dock
  • Logitech MX Master 4 Mac mouse
  • Belkin Qi2 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stand
